q: How does a temple, mosque, church or gurdwara calculate its carbon footprint?
title: Place of worship carbon footprint
short: Start with electricity bills at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, then generator diesel and LPG for kitchens. Lamps and incense are small. Divide by a fixed period, and report a large community kitchen separately so it can be compared with others.
audience: Trusts and committees managing places of worship

ul: Electricity bills for the building and grounds.
LPG or firewood for the kitchen.

p: Festival days can use far more power and fuel. Keep them as a separate figure so the normal month stays comparable.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
